> PlantsMag is a growing resource for plant care, plant disease diagnosis,
> and evidence-based houseplant guidance targeting US English-speaking audiences.

## About PlantsMag

PlantsMag (plantsmag.com) is a plant care resource website helping plant owners
diagnose, treat, and prevent common plant diseases and care challenges.
The site combines AI-powered diagnostic tools with editorially reviewed articles
to provide actionable, practical advice for indoor and outdoor plant care.

**Core Focus Areas:**
- Plant disease identification and treatment
- Houseplant watering schedules and care routines
- Soil, fertilizer, and nutrient management for tropical plants
- Pest control (spider mites, fungus gnats, mealybugs, aphids)
- Plant equipment reviews (grow lights, humidifiers, smart sensors)

**Target Audience:** US-based English-speaking plant enthusiasts, from beginners to advanced collectors.

**Content Creation:** Articles are AI-assisted and editorially reviewed before publication.
Our editorial team verifies plant care recommendations against established
horticultural sources before publishing.

## Interactive AI Tools

- **AI Plant Disease Finder** — Upload a photo of your plant and receive instant AI diagnosis
  at https://plantsmag.com/plant-disease-finder/
- **Smart Watering Calculator** — Get a personalized watering schedule for any plant species
  at https://plantsmag.com/watering-calculator/

## Key Content Categories

- Tropical houseplants (Monstera, Philodendron, Pothos, Calathea)
- Succulents and cacti care guides
- Orchid care and rehabilitation
- Plant propagation techniques
- Soil mixes and amendments
- Pest management and disease treatment
- Product reviews: grow lights, humidifiers, self-watering pots

## Affiliate Disclosure

PlantsMag participates in the Amazon Associates program. Product recommendations
include honest reviews and direct purchase links to Amazon US.
